QR Code generator library (TypeScript), Project Nayuki, MIT License — used by Telegram Desktop's lib_qr.
Source: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator (typescript-javascript/qrcodegen.ts). The only changes are
`export` on its namespaces so the renderer can import it, and a `@ts-nocheck` line for this app's stricter checks.
